means: The danbooru count tag for one female figure. The exact mirror of 1boy, and the same kind of instruction: a declaration of how many bodies exist, not a description of any of them.
does: Fixes the count at one female and gives every following tag something to attach to. It carries a local hazard on this box worth knowing before you use it: gen_cards.py, make_cards.py and make_samples.py all hardcode '1girl, female' into their NEGATIVE prompt, because every panel they render is of a male subject. A positive 1girl pushed through any of those scripts is fighting the negative and comes back mangled or male.
reach_for_it: as the first tag of any shot with exactly one female character - and only through a render path whose negative prompt you have actually read
used_in: no female characters exist in studio/characters/ yet - the library is male-only, which is exactly why 1girl currently sits in the sample generators' negative
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
